subject: Post-demo: SDK + routing delivery plan for BlueHarbor
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@blueharbor.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Cho <elaine@blueharbor.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up from today's demo: SDK & routing questions

Thanks for the demo today — good session. A couple of follow-ups we promised to capture:

- SDK onboarding: we have a small infra team who will run the initial proof-of-concept. They prefer a Python SDK + Docker example. Can you confirm API auth patterns (API key vs OIDC) and any sample container?
- Routing: we need a short doc on how Redwood will route requests by latency vs cost and what happens on overload (fallback chains). Are fallbacks per-customer-configurable?
- Structured output / tool calling: our ops team will need the model to respond with JSON that triggers downstream robotics orchestration — what are the guarantees around schema enforcement / validation?
- Embeddings & reranker: we'll ship a 200k vector index to start; curious about recommended batch sizes, quantization, and where reranking should run (edge vs cloud).

Attaching a short requirements sheet. Can we get a one-page plan for SDK + routing + policy configuration so we can align internally? Targeting a PoC in 3 weeks.

— Samir
Principal Engineer, BlueHarbor Robotics
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Elaine Cho <elaine@blueharbor.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo: SDK & routing questions

Samir — great to meet you and thanks for the notes + requirements sheet (received). Looping in Vivek (runtime/infra) and Marcus (model config/embeddings) so we can produce a concise PoC plan.

High-level answers and proposed next steps (we'll send a 1-pager and a Docker SDK example by EOD Monday):

1) SDK & auth
- We provide a Python SDK + a lightweight Docker example that authenticates with short-lived API keys for PoC. For production we support OIDC and customer-managed KMS; can provide an OIDC example using Auth0 or Okta.
- Sample: SDK init -> set region (us-east1), fallback policy id, and client-side KV cache TTL.

2) Routing & policy (summary)
- Policy model: route by policy priorities: (1) latency SLO, (2) cost cap, (3) model-compatibility. You declare priorities and thresholds; runtime enforces them.
- Fallbacks: chainable per-route. Example: gp-large-quantized -> gp-medium-8bit -> gp-small-4bit -> local-cache-response. Fallbacks are customer-configurable via the Console or API.
- Overload behavior: canary routing + autoscaling + automatic fallback to cheaper/compatible variants.

3) Structured output / tool calling
- We support strict schema enforcement by running model responses through a JSON schema validator on the server side; failing responses are flagged and optionally sent to a secondary parser. Function/tool calling supported via our Tools API; can provide a sample RL flow for your orchestration steps.

4) Embeddings & reranker ops
- For a 200k index we recommend starting with 8-bit quantization and a batched embedding pipeline (batch sizes 128–512 depending on GPU).
- Reranking: best-effort in-cloud for latency-sensitive calls; if you need sub-50ms on-site rerank, discuss edge deployment. Marcus will draft recommended batch/quantization defaults.

Action items we propose:
- Marcus: draft embedding + reranker config and recommended quantization (due 2027-05-14).
- Vivek: produce a short ops runbook for routing policies + fallback examples and sample Terraform snippets (due 2027-05-15).
- Sofia: deliver a 1-page PoC plan, Docker SDK sample, and a sample policy.json (due 2027-05-17).

If that timeline works we'll set a technical kick-off for the week of May 24 for the PoC. Samir/ Elaine — anything missing?

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@blueharbor.ai>
Date: 2027-05-14T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo: SDK & routing questions

Adding a few infra-specific notes for the PoC and items I want to confirm with BlueHarbor: 

- Region routing: default will be us-east1; we can replicate to eu-west1 but cross-region failover has a 150–300ms cold-penalty for KV cache misses. If they need deterministic geo routing we should pin region per-route.
- Latency policy enforcement: we support a soft and hard SLO. Soft triggers faster model variants + increased batching where acceptable; hard triggers immediate fallback and circuit-break to cached/partial responses. Need to know acceptable p50/p95 targets.
- KV/prefix cache behavior: cache population is async; for robotics orchestration with strong consistency requirements we recommend a short TTL (30s) + synchronous confirm step.
- Observability: we'll enable per-route traces and token-level latency breakdown in the Console for the PoC.

Two questions for BlueHarbor (Samir/ Elaine):
1) Target latency SLOs (p50, p95) for control-plane vs inference-plane?
2) Any hard cost cap per 1M tokens so we can prototype cost-aware routing policies?

I'll produce the runbook snippets (policy examples + Terraform) and attach them to Sofia's one-pager.

— Vivek
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@blueharbor.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Cho <elaine@blueharbor.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-16T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo: SDK & routing questions

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of clarifications:

- Latency targets: for live control signals we need p50 < 80ms and p95 < 200ms end-to-end (can tolerate a fallback with a 2x penalty in rare cases). For batch analytics calls p95 < 1s.
- Cost cap: we have an internal budget target of ~$1,200 / 1M tokens for the PoC phase (flexible for value). If Redwood can auto-fall back when cost projections exceed this, that would be ideal.
- Embeddings: we'll start with 200k vectors but can tier: 50k hot, rest cold. Rerank for the hot set only initially.

One operational ask: please include an example policy.json showing how to set the three prioritized rules (latency SLO, cost cap, region pin) and an example fallback chain that prefers quantized variants before dropping features.

Samir
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@blueharbor.ai>, Elaine Cho <elaine@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo: SDK & routing questions — confirmed PoC plan

Samir / Elaine — thanks for the quick answers. We've incorporated your latency and cost targets into the PoC plan. Attached: 1-page PoC plan, sample Docker SDK, policy.json example, and a short Terraform snippet for region routing. Highlights below: 

PoC scope (3 weeks)
- Week 1: SDK onboarding + auth (short-lived API keys), sample workload to run against us-east1.
- Week 2: Routing policy setup (we'll create a test route with priority rules: p50 / p95 thresholds, cost cap enforcement, region pin). Vivek will run canary traffic (10%).
- Week 3: Embeddings ingest (hot 50k / cold 150k), reranker for hot set, end-to-end validation with your orchestration.

Sample policy excerpt (what we'll deliver):
- priority: [latency_slo, cost_cap, region_pin]
- fallback_chain: [gp-large-8bit -> gp-medium-8bit -> gp-small-4bit -> cached_response]
- cost_cap: 1200 per_1M_tokens (PoC)
- region_pin: us-east1 (route-level override available)

Action owners & dates
- Marcus: embedding + reranker config & test harness (deliverable: 2027-05-20).
- Vivek: policy Terraform snippets + canary plan + runbook (deliverable: 2027-05-19).
- Sofia: SDK sample, policy.json, and PoC checklist (deliverable: 2027-05-18 — attached).

Next steps: confirm PoC kickoff slot for May 24; please reply with preferred time. I'll also open a HubSpot deal and share the Drive folder (links attached).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: blueharbor-demo-recording.mp4 (video), BH-Requirements-brief.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-routing-proposal-v1.pdf (PDF), architecture-diagram.png (image)
